title: Various SFO Submods (Soils Corrupted Units, Corrupted Compendium's Ensign Loi, Seu Extension Mod First Daughter and Last Shugengan, Corrupted Ascencion)
author: boib1150
description:
Various SFO updates to mods here.

Soils SFO is standalone and does not need the original file

Soil’s Corrupted Units SFO Changes

Units

General Unit Updates

-

All Chaos units updated to their SFO counterparts

-

All Vampire units updated to their SFO counterparts

-

Replaced Bestigors with SFO Slaangors

Soil Unique Unit Updates

-

Toxic Rocket and Cannon use their SFO Cathay counterparts for stats.

-

Rifle Cultist uses SFO Empire Handgunner stats

-

Pistolier Cav Cultist uses SFO Empire Pistolier Cav stats

-

Corrupted Dragon Uses SFO Chaos Dragon Stats

-

Bow and Glaive Cultist use SFO Kislev Ice guard Stats

-

Bow Cultist Uses SFO Empire Huntsmen RoR Stats

-

Greatsword Cultist uses SFO Empire Greatsword Stats

-

Spear and Shield Cultist uses SFO Cathay Celestial Dragon Guard Stats

-

Crossbow Cultist uses SFO Cathay Celestial Crossbowmen Stats

-

Dual Sword Cultist Uses SFO High Elf Ranger Stats

Ensign Loi SFO Changes

Requires Corrupted Compendium

-

Now replenishes or trains allied armies

-

Assaults units and garrison

-

Spread public order

-

Training and Replenish are no longer part of the linked skill line

-

Re-ordered skill display

-

Changed Sohporic Musk and Elven Grudge to Glamour of Slaanesh and Alurre of Slaanesh

-

Updated stats for SFO

-

Added 10% Physical resist

-

Nerfed Missle resist from 15% to 10%

Also available is a small patch for double skill points adding a skill dump. Requires this mod <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2831951203>

Seu First Daughter and Last Shugengan SFO Changes

Requires

-

HP changed to 10,000 for both heroes and lords

-

Nerfed Last Shugengan MA, MD, and Weapon Damage

-

Buffed First Daughter MA and MD

-

Shugengan Dragon form uses SFO Chaos Dragon Stats

-

First Daughter given fatigue immune

堕落升魔 (Corruption Ascend) 1.2 SFO Changes

-

All unit's health brought up to SFO levels

-

Nerfed Transformed Miao Speed

-

Small adjustments to all unit’s stats

-

Barrier increased to SFO Levels for Ice Guard

-

Ogre charge is given to Katarin's Kholek form

-

Perfect Vigour given to Miao Keeper form
